summary: The repo ships a real, re-runnable comparison notebook (63 vendor-written NVIDIA 10-K questions, LLM judge, saved outputs) showing PageIndex at 100.0% accuracy vs 42.9-92.1% for vector RAG configurations, though the vector answers and judge grades are not committed and the run depends on paid APIs. The headline README numbers (FinanceBench 98.7%, 97% token cut, financial-QA benchmark) point to external vendor repos/blogs, while the indexing cost/time and native-PDF cost ratios are plots with no committed harness.
